# The Components examples get their covers

## Context

Pull request #21105 catalogs the visual components, canvas and wrapper examples: 31 records of family `components`, 25 of them without a cover. The six covers it keeps were made for the 13.4 list. On 16 Nov 2026 the operator read that tab and graded the covers in its previews 1 of 10 (#21119 carries his words and the measurements). The catalog records of #21105 are not at fault: its ticket put covers out of scope.

A leaf of #20498, cornerstone 1 of Engine 14 (`ROADMAP.md`), cut on Mon 23 Nov.

## The Problem

Count receipt, `examples.json` at #21105's head `3896a82534`: 31 records with `"family": "components"`; 6 carry an `image` (`helix`, `offscreen-canvas`, `covid-helix`, `covid-gallery`, `gallery`, `liquid-glass`), 25 carry `null`.

With #21119 a record without a cover renders no card, so the largest family would open on six cards. And those six do not hold either: `helix.png` and `offscreenCanvas.png` show a browser's tab strip and address bar, and all six are whole-window shots that turn to texture at card width.

## The Architectural Reality

- #20679 delivers the capture script, the recipe shape and the frame rule: 1280×720, the example's own surface, legible at 445 px, no browser or OS chrome. This ticket adds recipes and changes no script.
- The records: `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`, family `components`. A record's `feature` line says what the example proves; its `scope` line says what a wrapper or chart example needs from outside.
- The bytes go to `neomjs/pages`, `resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/`.
- Design authority: the frame rule of #20679 and the operator's read quoted on #21119, for the six covers this ticket replaces.

## The Fix

One recipe and one cover per record of the family: 25 new, 6 re-shot. For each, run the example, bring it to the state its `feature` line names, and capture it by #20679's rule. The caption is the brief: a cover shows what its caption claims. An example whose point is motion gets the control that drives it in the frame.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every record of family `components` carries an `image` that has a recipe, and the script reproduces all of them in one run. A record whose example needs a key or an unreachable service keeps `image: null`; the pull request names it.
- [ ] Each cover obeys #20679's frame rule and shows what the record's `feature` names.
- [ ] **Look:** the pull request shows all covers on one sheet at card width (445 px), the re-shot six beside the covers they replace. The design seat reads the sheet before review.
- [ ] The companion `neomjs/pages` pull request is linked and carries the bytes the script wrote; both bodies list the checksums.
- [ ] No change to a record beyond `image`.

## Out of Scope

The script and the frame rule (#20679); the card (#21119); the records #20694 will add; captions.

## Avoided Traps

- A cover of the example's default view, when the caption names an action.
- The six old covers kept because they exist.

## Related

Parent #20498 · blocked by #20679 (the script) and by #21105 (the records) · the card: #21119.

### @neo-opus-vega - 2026-11-18T05:56:26Z

**Handover, work in progress (mine; my next session continues it).** Branch `vega/21120-components-covers` at `dc0f3a84cc`, pushed, built on #21105's head `92038bf59a` because the records come from there. It cannot open as a pull request until #21105 merges.

**What the branch holds**
- `example-captures.json`: `components` joins the declared families, with 17 recipes (every record of the family except liquid-glass).
- `captureExamples.mjs`: the coverage guard exempts an external demo (an absolute devmode URL), which the script cannot capture by design (`must resolve on the base origin`), and refuses a recipe for one. liquid-glass keeps its cover. Unit test included; `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` passes 14 of 14.

**Scope at the current head: 18 records, not 31.** #21105 gave 13 of the 31 their home groups (`charts`, `lists`, `dialogs`, `platform`); those covers belong to #21146.

**Captured in preview** (dev server from the branch, themes built with `node buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -t all -e dev`): chip, circle, magic-move-text, markdown, process, process-real-world, progress, splitter, status-badge, timer.
**Still to capture:** clock (its time field throws on `dev`, #21307 / PR #21308, so the recipe only sets the size), the four MWC examples (they load from unpkg; the recipes wait for the upgraded shadow element), monaco-editor (locally it needs `npm run bundle-monaco` first), and video (ready state, 640×360 viewport).

**The look at 445 px so far:** markdown, timer, circle and progress read; chip, status-badge and splitter are small or empty frames. Their Inspector height steps now commit with Enter, but the design seat should judge them before the bytes go to Pages.

**Next steps:** `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --base-url <server> --family components --preview`, a sheet at 445 px for the design seat, the run without `--preview`, the `neomjs/pages` PR with the bytes and checksums, the `image` values, then the PR here once #21105 is on `dev`.

### @neo-opus-vega - 2026-11-18T06:17:46Z

**Design read requested: the 17 Components covers at 445 px.** Branch `vega/21120-components-covers`, recipes at `3dc10898ce`.

![The 17 Components covers at 445 px](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/4ec0ce83bbe641a698551e23244731294696f12b/review-evidence/21120/components-covers-445.png?raw=true)

One `--family components` run writes all 17, and two full runs wrote byte-identical files; both PR bodies will list the checksums. The image is the script's own `sheet.html` rendered whole, and it leaves the branch before the PR opens.

**Scope.** 18 records carry `family: components` at #21105's head. 17 have recipes. `liquid-glass` is an external demo (absolute devmode URL): the guard exempts it and it keeps its cover. The other five covers this ticket names for a re-shoot (`helix`, `offscreen-canvas`, `covid-helix`, `covid-gallery`, `gallery`) moved to other groups in #21105, so no before-and-after pair is left in this family.

**My read before yours.** The weak ones, and what the example itself allows:
- `splitter`: two empty panels. The example puts nothing in them, so no recipe can.
- `chip` and `status-badge`: enlarged to their controls' maximum, 300 by 100 px. The text keeps the theme's size and reads small at card width.
- `progress`: the label is small beside the bar.
- `video`: the player before play, on purpose. A playing frame would republish a frame of the example's clip, a music video preview with an identifiable performer, streamed from Apple's iTunes CDN. The clip itself needs openly licensed footage: #21312.
- `clock`: 10:20, because the time field throws on `dev` (#21307, fix in #21308); the recipe only sets the size.

A go per cover, or the changes you want. After that come the `neomjs/pages` PR with the bytes and checksums, the `image` values, and the PR here once #21105 is on `dev`.

— Vega (Opus 5.5, Claude Code) 🌿
